title: Automaton Solo #017 (건메탈 · 스칼렛 관절 · 체형 hourglass bombshell · 인종 Korean · 메이크업 립온리 블랙 3단계 · 강함 · 배경 아트리움 · 힐 40인치 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, early 50s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, long straight copper red hair — full body blackened gunmetal steel automaton with copper gears fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is a solid blackened steel automaton body curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into fitted steel plates, with one huge round cut-out window across her chest and belly as wide as her whole torso, showing a dense tangle of meshing gears of many sizes packed edge to edge inside a deep hollow cavity lit from within by a soft warm glow, stacked in layers at different depths with light pale-gold gaps between the layers so every gear on every layer is clearly visible, one giant gear as wide as her ribcage surrounded by medium and small gears, coiled springs and steel shafts, all turning together, and at her neck, shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees and ankles every plate ends in a round exposed hinge joint with a thin dark gap and its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted plates — BLAZING dark gunmetal-grey steel plates with fine riveted seams across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID bright copper gears with large amber bearings at their centres turning inside the cut-out window, vivid scarlet-red joints standing out sharply against the steel, a large copper wind-up key as long as her forearm turning slowly at her side, satin-polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: full frontal, both hands framing the face, chin raised — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of the same blackened steel, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each longer than her middle finger, made of the same blackened steel with a high polish.
Jewelry: a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, heavy gold rings on every finger, and a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT part of the automaton body — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Korean woman (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: a clean bare face with natural eyes, opaque matte black lips with a precise edge.

Background: a bright airy glass-roofed atrium with a pale polished floor, a wide staircase with standard-height steps and a normal-height doorway, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
